messages.author: Daniel Esposito
messages.text: applovin_roas_d7 has been out of learning for a week. I'd like to lower the D7 ROAS target from 24% to 22% so it can scale into more inventory. CPI is ~$1.30 and it's our best D7 ROAS channel right now.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: OK with 22%. What are we comparing against, are you using the new D7 ROAS definition (mature cohorts only, spend for the same cohorts)?

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Yes, the one on the *Metric Definitions* page, not the old blended one.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Confirming: AppLovin D7 ROAS on mature cohorts is the best of the five networks, Google is the lowest. Fine to loosen the target a bit.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Approved. Change it tomorrow morning so we don't mix two targets in the same day.
